atAGlance: Lẩu chay is vegetarian hot pot, usually with mushrooms, tofu, greens, noodles, and vegetable broth.
whatItIs: Lẩu chay is vegetarian hot pot with vegetable broth, tofu, mushrooms, greens, herbs, and noodles. The broth should taste clean, earthy, and light.
howToEnjoy: Add mushrooms and tofu first, greens next, and noodles near the end. Ask whether the broth and dip are fully vegetarian if the restaurant is mixed.
howLocalsOrder: Order lẩu chay by table size and ask for no fish sauce if fish sauce needs to stay out of the broth and dip. Ask for extra mushrooms or noodles before the pot starts.
worthKnowing: Chay hot pot is common at vegetarian restaurants and Buddhist-style eateries, but mixed restaurants may need a clearer no-fish-sauce request.
goodToKnow: Ask whether the broth and dip are fully vegetarian if needed.
travelerCaution: Ask whether the broth and dip are fully vegetarian if needed.
